empty.title: No growth readings yet.
empty.body: Your baby’s discharge weight is shown until a new reading is added.

validation.futureDate: Reading date cannot be in the future.
validation.weightRange: Weight must be between 400 g and 8000 g.
validation.lengthRange: Length must be between 20.0 cm and 80.0 cm.
validation.headRange: Head circumference must be between 15.0 cm and 55.0 cm.
validation.notesLength: Notes must be 300 characters or fewer.

errors.load: We could not load growth readings.
errors.duplicate: A growth reading already exists for this date.

weightGainNote.normalFirstWeek: Some weight loss in the first week is normal. Weight gain usually starts from around day 7–10.
weightGainNote.excessLossFirstWeek: Weight loss is more than 10% of birth weight. Mention this at your next visit or contact your health worker.
weightGainNote.regainingWeight: Your baby is in the weight-recovery phase. By day 14, birth weight should be regained.
weightGainNote.notRegainedByDay14: Birth weight has not been regained yet by day 14. Please discuss this with your health worker at the next visit.
weightGainNote.weightLossAfterRecovery: Weight has decreased since the last reading. Consider discussing this at your next visit.
weightGainNote.steadyGain: Weight gain is progressing. Expected rate is around 25–30 g per day at this age.
weightGainNote.doubleWeightMilestone: Your baby should double their birth weight around 4–5 months corrected age. Keep tracking at each visit.
weightGainNote.doubledBirthWeight: Your baby has doubled their birth weight — a great milestone!
weightGainNote.onTrack: Weight gain is on track. Keep attending follow-up visits.

fields.kmcTargetHint: You can enter total minutes for today.
fields.sleepHint: Normal: 16–18 hours/day, waking every 2–3 hours to feed.
fields.urinationTargetHint: Target: at least 6 times in 24 hours
fields.urinationLowWarning: Less than 6 times may mean the baby is not feeding enough — check the Danger Signs guide.
fields.stoolAbnormal: Was any stool watery or loose today?
fields.stoolAbnormalHint: Watery stool (not the normal soft yellow) is a danger sign — check the Danger Signs guide.
fields.feedingLowWarning: Fewer than 8 feeds today is below the target. If your baby is also refusing to feed or seems unwell, check the Danger Signs guide now.
fields.sleepAbnormalWarning: If your baby is very hard to wake or is missing feeds due to sleepiness, this can be a danger sign — check the Danger Signs guide.
fields.tempOutOfRangeWarning: Temperature outside 36–37.5°C is a danger sign (fever or hypothermia). Check the Danger Signs guide and seek help if needed.

validation.feedsCount: Feeds must be an integer between 0 and 30.
validation.volumeMl: Volume must be an integer between 0 and 2000.
validation.kmcMinutes: KMC minutes must be an integer between 0 and 1440.
validation.morningTemp: Morning temperature must be between 30.0 and 43.0 °C (at most 1 decimal place).
validation.eveningTemp: Evening temperature must be between 30.0 and 43.0 °C (at most 1 decimal place).
validation.weightGrams: Weight must be an integer between 400 and 7000 grams.
validation.urinationCount: Urination count must be an integer between 0 and 30.

dangerSignsFull.title: Danger Signs
dangerSignsFull.subtitle: Know when to seek immediate care
dangerSignsFull.checkerSubtitle: Select any signs you are seeing right now
dangerSignsFull.checkerInstruction: Tap all the signs that apply, then press Check.
dangerSignsFull.noSymptomsSelected: Select at least one sign to check.
dangerSignsFull.referenceSubtitle: Tap any sign to see what to look for and what to do

symptoms.cold_and_feeding_poorly: Baby feels cold AND is feeding poorly
symptoms.breathing_abnormal: Breathing too fast or too slow (not 30–60 breaths/min)
symptoms.gasping_noisy_breathing: Grunting, gasping, chest indrawing, or nostrils flaring
symptoms.blue_discoloration: Lips, tongue, or skin appear blue
symptoms.feels_cold: Body feels cold to touch (temperature below 36°C)
symptoms.cord_infection_signs: Cord: redness, swelling, pus, or bad smell
symptoms.limp_floppy: Body is limp or floppy — arms and legs not flexed
symptoms.lethargic: Very inactive, difficult to wake, not responding
symptoms.eye_discharge: Red or swollen eyelids with pus
symptoms.excessive_sleepiness: Very hard to wake, missing feeds due to sleepiness
symptoms.watery_stool: Watery or liquid stool (not normal soft yellow stool)
symptoms.persistent_vomiting: Vomiting large amounts repeatedly (not normal spit-up)
symptoms.poor_feeding: Unable to suck, tires out quickly, or refuses to feed
